description.zh: 无需智能体主动检索，在每次发送消息时自动把记忆库中的记忆（标题，可选附带摘要或完整正文）直接注入到输入上下文，并支持工具箱配置注入位置与内容策略。
description.en: Automatically inject memories (titles, optionally with snippets or full content) from the memory library into the model input on every message, with toolbox settings for injection target and content strategy.
description.default: Automatically inject memories into the input context on every message.
